metaDescription: English-language translation services for business documents and websites for the UK, Europe and worldwide. Contact us for a free quote today!
bodyHtml:
English translation services

Why choose BeTranslated for your English language translation?

Get a Quote
Watch Our Video

English translations with global reach at BeTranslated

English is one of BeTranslated’s most requested languages, as both a source and target language. We regularly translate to and from English into major global languages, which include French, German, Spanish, Arabic, Chinese, and Japanese, to name just a few.

By revolving our services around high-demand language pairs, we’re able to provide accurate English-language translation services with a primary focus on a very high level of service, and a quick turnaround time.

 

What are the pros of English-language translation?



English helps you reach over 380 million people

English is the mother tongue of approximately 380 million, and the second language of over a billion people. After Chinese and Hindi, it’s the world’s third most widely-spoken global language.

Our essential English-language translation services can translate your website and key documents into the lingua franca of business, travel, and international relations, irrespective of your geographical location.



English-language translation to reach every continent

English is the principal language of the United Kingdom, and the official language of Australia, Canada, Ireland, New Zealand, and most other Commonwealth countries.

As well as being the most widely spoken non-native language worldwide, English is the default language of the internet and technology.



English-language translation for international e-commerce

The United Kingdom currently has the second-highest GDP in Europe, and English-speaking nations remain a dominant force in global markets and the financial world.

The UK imports large quantities of electronic equipment, motor vehicles, pharmaceutical products, and mineral fuels, making international business relations with the country appealing to foreign investors.



English Is the most common international language

English is the most spoken and second most studied foreign language in the world. Its far-reaching influence in cinema, gaming, music, international news, science, social networks, and general internet browsing, make it the go-to second language for many.

Using our English-language translation services makes your website more discoverable to people all over the world.

Our featured English translators
Kerry
French to English translator in the IT field

Kerry translates exclusively from French into English. Due to his experience and expertise, he specialises in many fields, including computer science, security, software, and hardware, but also economics, human rights, and other related fields.
Nancy
French-English translator specialising in aeronautics

Nancy brings her experience and attention to detail to BeTranslated’s clients by offering translations between French and English, as well as proofreading, editing, and writing services. She is also the representative of BeTranslated in the United States.
Andy
French to English business translator

Andy has been a freelance French to English translator since 2005 and also works as a language teacher. In addition to French, he also skilfully translates from Spanish and Catalan into English for a large number of international clients.
Tony
Professional French to English translator

Tony has been working as a full-time French-English translator for 10 years. He actually got into this profession when he moved to the French countryside. He specialises in various fields, ranging from the technical to the commercial sector, particularly specialising in the property market and tourism industry.
